context: Two managers discuss a school PTA event
purpose: Teach: 山崎/藤原/松井/青山/坂本/近藤/石井/中島

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 子供のクラス、PTAの連絡網、山崎さんと藤原さんが幹事。
lines.en: My kid's class has a PTA contact group — Yamazaki-san and Fujiwara-san are coordinating it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pace, organizing information as she speaks. Light breath between clauses. No performance, just laying out the facts with mild routine fatigue.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うちは松井さんと青山さん。皆さん熱心ですよね。
lines.en: Ours has Matsui-san and Aoyama-san. Everyone's pretty committed, aren't they.
lines.style: Gentle agreement with warmth underneath. Slightly slower than hers. A quiet nod in the voice — the recognition of good people doing good work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 運動会、坂本さんが司会、近藤さんが進行担当。
lines.en: For sports day, Sakamoto-san's doing the announcements and Kondo-san's managing the schedule.
lines.style: Brighter energy here. Listing details with a touch of lightness, like he's settling into the topic. Natural, conversational pacing, no strain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 石井さんが、応援団指導も兼ねてくれてる。
lines.en: And Ishii-san's been coaching the cheering squad on top of everything else.
lines.style: Soft admiration in the tone. A beat of recognition — noticing someone carrying extra weight. Quiet, steady. Not a complaint, just an observation of generosity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中島さん、写真係でいつもお世話になります。
lines.en: Nakajima-san's always the photographer. We owe them so much.
lines.style: Warm and sincere, tinged with gentle gratitude. Slower closing. Slight trailing-off that carries the weight of real appreciation, not politeness.
